purpose: Test a new NFP source family after preserving the Baker route failure. CPI route is not re-optimized here.
universe: All 12 frozen 2021 Employment Situation/NFP release events from the existing BLS manifest.
source_family: Reuters pre-release poll/reporting, including verbatim Reuters syndication on public mirrors when the Reuters byline/body and publication timestamp are preserved.
snapshot_rule: For each event, use the latest qualifying Reuters publication timestamped strictly before BLS T0 that explicitly reports Reuters poll consensus. No post-release Reuters article may qualify.
cutoff_rule: publication_timestamp_utc < T0; equality fails. Same-day evidence requires explicit timestamp/timezone or an independently resolvable publisher clock.
field_rule: All four fields must be explicit in the qualifying Reuters text. No inference, no conversion from another source, no averaging, no substitution.
version_rule: Preserve URL/article identity, publication timestamp, Reuters attribution, retrieval time and content hash/normalized evidence hash. If a mirror exposes only a mutable undated current page, it fails.
conflict_rule: If multiple qualifying Reuters snapshots before T0 disagree, select the latest qualifying timestamp per the frozen rule; preserve earlier snapshots as version history. Never average.
missing_rule: Missing required fields remain null and the event is incomplete.
note: This is a new source route, not a rewrite of the failed Baker census. It was frozen before the full 12-event Reuters census.
